title: Work IQ: memory profile path in Work IQ MCP for agents
summary: The roadmap facts, billing model and documented control paths are supported. The briefing appropriately distinguishes existing memory controls from the planned agent memory path; the statement about personal preferences needs an additional source citation.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The planned Work IQ MCP path /memory/me/coreMemories gives authorised agents access to a user's memory profile.
claims.quote: A new Work IQ MCP path, /memory/me/coreMemories, gives authorized agents access to a user’s memory profile.

claims.claim: The profile enables more personalised and relevant assistance.
claims.quote: This profile enables agents to provide more personalized and relevant assistance.

claims.claim: The launch profile includes Custom Instructions.
claims.quote: At launch, it includes Custom Instructions, Saved Memories, relevant work account data, and memories derived from chat history.

claims.claim: No tenant admin-centre UI for enhanced personalization is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot enhanced personalization memory tenant admin center turn off UI enhancedPersonalizationSetting'. Read Manage Copilot personalization and memory and Enhanced personalization control overview; found Graph configuration and user UI, not a tenant admin UI.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: table and prose
claims.claim: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization with {"isEnabledInOrganization": false} turns off enhanced personalization.
Enhanced personalization can control Copilot memory for the tenant.
claims.quote: No action is required to turn on Copilot memory; you only need to turn off Copilot memory for end-users or the tenant if desired.

claims.claim: Enhanced personalization is on by default.
claims.quote: By default, Enhanced personalization is turned on.

claims.claim: Copilot personalization and memory are in preview and subject to change.
claims.quote: Copilot personalization and memory are in preview and subject to change.

claims.claim: The printed Graph operation uses the beta API and is subject to change.
claims.quote: APIs under the `/beta` version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: The Graph update operation requires PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All.
claims.quote:
| Delegated (work or school account) | PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All | Not available. |
| Application | PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All | Not available. |

claims.claim: People Administrator is the required least-privileged role for delegated use of this operation.
claims.quote: For delegated access using work or school accounts, the admin must be assigned a supported Microsoft Entra role. People Administrator is the least privileged role supported for this operation.

claims.claim: Turning enhanced personalization off disables the saved memories control.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off. They can't turn on these settings.

claims.claim: Turning enhanced personalization off disables the chat history personalization control.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off. They can't turn on these settings.

claims.claim: Turning enhanced personalization off disables custom instructions.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Custom instruction control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying custom instructions, but doesn't remove those custom instructions.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio makers toggle memory at agent > Build > components panel > Memory toggle.
claims.quote:
1. Create or open the agent in Copilot Studio.
2. Select the Build tab.
3. In the components panel, use the Memory toggle to turn the feature on or off.

claims.claim: An API equivalent for the Microsoft Copilot harness agent Memory toggle is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Studio Microsoft Copilot harness Memory toggle API PowerShell turn off'. Read Memory (Microsoft Copilot) (preview); the documented toggle is maker-side UI and no corresponding automation call was found.

claims.claim: The cited Copilot Studio memory control applies to agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness.
claims.quote: This article describes Memory for agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.claim: This Copilot Studio memory capability is in preview.
claims.quote: This is a production-ready preview feature.

claims.where: controls[1].scope, controls[1].note; Governance controls: table and prose
claims.claim: The maker controls memory on or off for each Copilot Studio agent.
claims.quote: As the maker, you turn Memory on or off for each agent.

claims.claim: If a user does not interact with the agent for 28 days, their memories from that agent are deleted.
claims.quote: If a user doesn't interact with the agent for 28 days, the system deletes their memories from that agent.

claims.claim: Turning this agent's Memory toggle off does not delete stored memories.
claims.quote: Turning Memory off doesn't delete stored memories. It only prevents the agent from using them.

claims.claim: Work IQ MCP tenant policy is reached in the Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools.
4. In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP.
5. On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.claim: An API call equivalent to the tenant Work IQ MCP policy toggle is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Work IQ MCP tenant policy settings API PATCH PowerShell turn on off'; '"Work IQ" "policy" "API" "PATCH"'. Read Policy governance for Work IQ MCP and MCP overview; no callable policy-toggle endpoint or command found.

claims.claim: Administrators can turn Work IQ MCP policy on or off at tenant scope.
claims.quote: In the initial release, Work IQ MCP provides tenant-level policy control. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, tenant administrators can turn Work IQ MCP policy on or off for the tenant.

claims.claim: Purview retention policies do not apply to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: Retention policies and retention labels configured in Purview by organization admins don't apply to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Admins cannot restrict which types of information are added to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: No, admins can't restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Saved memories are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer.
claims.quote: Saved memories and inferred memories from your chat history are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer.

claims.claim: Memories inferred from chat history are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer.
claims.quote: Saved memories and inferred memories from your chat history are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer.

claims.claim: Custom instructions are not discoverable through those admin discovery solutions.
claims.quote: Custom instructions aren't accessible, but can manually be exported by the user through Settings > Personalization.

claims.claim: Admins can delete memory data using Microsoft Graph Explorer in combination with Purview.
claims.quote: An admin can also delete memory data through Microsoft Graph Explorer in combination with Purview.

claims.claim: Application of the existing memory retention, discovery and deletion guidance to the new memory path is not yet confirmed.

claims.claim: How the new memory profile path interacts with enhanced personalization or the Copilot Studio memory toggle is not yet documented.
